All 2,736 stored pure-Kerr roots pass the recorded numerical gates and independent comparison; no formal root enclosure is claimed.
The two retained first-order reconstructions pass their local residual and overlap gates; they are golden evidence, not a public provider.
Eight mode-conditioned 220 benchmark disks reproduce the published plus and minus shifts at four spins; no universal two-dimensional EFT operator is claimed.
